product.name: RTHM Clinic
product.description: A telehealth service providing expert clinician visits, comprehensive lab testing, and access to treatments for complex illnesses like Long COVID and ME/CFS.

product.name: RTHM Direct
product.description: An online assessment and medication access service offering simplified access to low-risk treatments for Long COVID and related conditions without requiring clinician visits.

product.name: RTHM Lab GPCR+ Autoantibody Panel
product.description: A specialized laboratory test measuring autoantibodies against G-protein coupled receptors and ACE2 to aid in understanding complex illnesses like Long COVID and ME/CFS.
